newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call easy, t-bills auctions to decide rates.
newsitem.headline: Indian call easy, t-bills auctions to decide rates.

text.p: Indian call money rates opened steady at 0.10-0.50 percent in dull trade on reporting Friday, dealers said.
Three day money was being quoted at 3.00-3.50 percent, 15- day money at 6.0 percent and 90 days term money at 10.25 percent for lending, a dealer a Andhra Bank said.
"Bankers expect the 14-day treasury bills auction to yield 5.00-5.25 percent," he said.

Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is expected to raise 10.0 to 15.0 billion rupees in Friday's maiden auction of 14-day treasury bills auction which will test the market sentiment and reactions, a state-run bank dealer said.
Another dealer said the market was flush with funds and an outflow of over 30.0 billion rupees towards the 14-day treasury bills auction may push up call rates above 4.5 percent levels.
